item.title: Love Dispute Turns Fatal in Pune as Nigerian National Emeka Christian Dies After Brutal Assault - The Logical Indian

item.description: Israel announces immediate disengagement from seven UN bodies citing anti-Israel bias and bureaucratic inefficiency.

item.title: India’s Silent Vitamin B12 Crisis: Why Nearly Half the Population May Be Deficient Without Knowing It - The Logical Indian
item.description: Widespread Vitamin B12 deficiency in India is often missed, misdiagnosed, and underestimated despite serious long-term health consequences.

item.title: People of Purpose: How Dr. Lopamudra Priyadarshini Is Building Communities Through CSR Beyond Charity - The Logical Indian
item.description: From tribal Odisha's humble beginnings to leading Hindalco's CSR initiatives, Dr. Priyadarshini has empowered hundreds of entrepreneurs and thousands of women, proving purpose-driven change transforms communities.

item.title: Over 200 Sikhs Rescue Teen Allegedly Abducted, Raped by Pakistani Grooming Gang in London - The Logical Indian
item.description: Over 200 Sikhs in West London rescued a 16-year-old girl from an alleged grooming gang after years of exploitation.

item.title: Bengaluru’s Kadirenahalli Garbage Crisis Exposes Civic Gaps, Health Risks and Urgent Need for Collective Responsibility - The Logical Indian
item.description: Despite civic interventions, persistent garbage dumping along Kadirenahalli’s Outer Ring Road continues to endanger public health and mobility.

item.title: MEA Advisory Issued: Indians Urged to Leave Iran as Security Situation Deteriorates - The Logical Indian
item.description: As protests and instability persist in Iran, India’s MEA has advised citizens to avoid non-essential travel and remain vigilant or leave if possible.
